methods.steps: Open input; File > Export As; name output.jpg; choose JPEG export settings.
methods.limits: Saving is lossy; the JPEG export keeps neither transparency nor layers.

methods.steps: File > Open; File > Export As > JPG; save download.
methods.limits: Saving as JPG is lossy.

methods.steps: Open JPEG; File > Export; Format: TIFF; Save.
methods.limits: Mac only.

methods.steps: File > Export As; output.tiff; choose TIFF compression.
methods.limits: LZW and Deflate are lossless; JPEG compression is lossy.

methods.steps: magick input.jpeg -compress LZW output.tiff
methods.limits: Options go before the output file name.

methods.steps: File > Export As; choose output.avif; confirm AVIF export settings.
methods.limits: The output name ends in .avif.

methods.steps: magick photo.jpg photo.avif
methods.limits: AVIF is listed as readable and writable.

methods.steps: avifenc -q 75 photo.jpg photo.avif
methods.limits: Built with at least one AV1 codec enabled; none is on by default.

methods.steps: Insert > Pictures > This Device; select JPG; Insert; save the file.
methods.limits: DOCX is Word's default for new documents.

methods.steps: Insert > Image; select JPG with linking disabled; File > Save As; choose a Microsoft Word format.
methods.limits: LibreOffice opens and saves Word DOCX files.

methods.steps: File > Open; load JPG; File > Save as PSD.
methods.limits: Photopea uses PSD as its main document format.

methods.steps: magick picture.jpg picture.psd
methods.limits: PSD is listed as readable and writable.

methods.steps: tesseract page.jpg result -l eng
methods.limits: English is the default language if -l is omitted.

methods.steps: Upload JPEG; right-click; Open with > Google Docs; copy recognized text into a plain-text editor.
methods.limits: Uploads the image; 2 MB or less; right-side up.

methods.steps: Insert picture; Control-click; Copy Text from Picture; paste into a text editor.
methods.limits: Uses Microsoft online services; handwriting may not be recognized well.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i input.m4v -vn -b:a 128k -c:a libmp3lame soundtrack.mp3
methods.limits: Decoding the input requires the relevant decoders.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -f flv -codec:v libx264 -codec:a aac output.flv
methods.limits: Needs H.264 and AAC encoders.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -c copy -f flv output.flv
methods.limits: An FLV holds at most one video and one audio stream.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -codec:v libx264 -codec:a aac -flvflags add_keyframe_index output.flv
methods.limits: The index aids seeking.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -target ntsc-dvd output.mpg
methods.limits: Choose the correct standard; authoring remains separate.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i input.mp4 -target pal-vcd output.mpg
methods.limits: Sets Video CD parameters; choose pal- or ntsc- to suit the gear.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i input.mpv -an -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:v libx264 output.mp4
methods.limits: Video only; the MP4 has no audio.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i input.mpv -c:v copy -an output.mp4
methods.limits: Video only; the MP4 keeps the MPEG video.

methods.steps: ffmpeg -i input.mpv -an -movflags +faststart -c:v libx264 -pix_fmt yuv420p output.mp4
methods.limits: Second pass moves the index; not possible with fragmented output.
